notes.title: v.1.2.0 patch notes
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] The mystery of the disappearing pigeons has been solved 👀
[*] Steam achievements you haven't gotten (but deserve!) will appear on the game launch
[*] Missing cursor bug has been fixed (hopefully!) by adding the custom cursor option
[*] Minor text corrections
[/olist]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Added cloud saves
[*] Added custom cursor
[*] Added borderless mode
[/olist]

notes.title: v.1.1.1a minor bug fix
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
1. Fixed not receiving in-Steam achievements for keeping birds (if already received, you should get the Steam achievement on the next startup)

notes.title: v.1.1.0 patch notes
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
1. Fixed saving windowed mode + added saving size and position of the window
2. Changed logic for hold buttons to prevent malfunctioning on display with different refresh rate

[h2]Updates[/h2]
1. Separated sound toggles: ui sounds, ambient and pigeon sounds

notes.title: v.1.0.1a bug fixes
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]

1. Fixed issue with getting the Bird Cupid achievement (10 pairs simultaneously)
2. Fixed minor issue with resetting progress
3. Corrected some item and button descriptions
